notablePrerequisites:
Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore.
Activate Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore by tapping it.
When Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
